question: What characterizes the one who is freed from all duality and intent on practice?
premises: One is freed from all duality.
These qualities describe the same subject.
inference: The one freed from all duality is devoted to practice beyond habitual effort.
uncertainties: The compound gatābhyāsa is read as having gone beyond practice; interpretation is tentative.
plain_english: He is freed from all duality and intent on what lies beyond practice.
